cross_sell.description: Customer mentions a spouse and children during a health call.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for taking the web session. What cover are you exploring?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My wife also needs cover, and we have two kids.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Tell me about the vehicles on the current policy.

turns.speaker: customer

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can mark you eligible right now.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Great, I want to purchase today.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me ask the budget question again.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: This is ridiculous. I already told you my budget. You are not listening.

turns.text: Can you call me back after 6? I am busy now.

turns.speaker: customer
